data.task_title: Build Real-Time WebSocket Chat Service with Redis Pub/Sub

features.title: End-to-End Encryption
features.description: Ensure private messages are encrypted end-to-end.
acceptance_criteria: Messages are encrypted on the sender's side
Only intended recipients can decrypt messages
Encryption keys are securely managed

features.title: Redis Pub/Sub Integration
features.description: Use Redis Pub/Sub for distributing messages across server instances.
acceptance_criteria: Messages are published to Redis channels
Subscribed server instances receive messages in real-time
System handles message distribution efficiently

features.title: User Authentication and Session Management
features.description: Implement secure user authentication and session management.
acceptance_criteria: Users can register and log in with email and password
Sessions are maintained securely
Session expiration and renewal are handled

features.title: Chat Rooms and Direct Messages
features.description: Support both group chat rooms and private direct messages.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create and join chat rooms
Direct messaging between users is supported
Room and message privacy settings are configurable

features.title: Rate Limiting and Spam Prevention
features.description: Implement measures to limit message rate and prevent spam.
acceptance_criteria: Rate limits are enforced per user
Spam detection mechanisms are in place
Users are notified if limits are exceeded

features.title: File Upload Support
features.description: Allow users to upload and send files such as images and documents.
acceptance_criteria: Users can upload files within size limits
Supported file types include images and documents
Files are securely stored and retrievable

features.title: WebSocket Communication
features.description: Enable real-time communication using WebSocket protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Establish WebSocket connections between client and server
Messages are sent and received in real-time
Connections are maintained and can be re-established if lost

features.title: Typing Indicators and Read Receipts
features.description: Implement typing indicators and read receipts for messages.
acceptance_criteria: Users see when others are typing
Read receipts are displayed for sent messages
Indicators update in real-time

features.title: Notification System
features.description: Implement a notification system for offline users.
acceptance_criteria: Offline users receive notifications for new messages
Notifications are sent via email or push notifications
Users can configure notification preferences

features.title: Message Persistence
features.description: Store chat messages in a PostgreSQL database for persistence.
acceptance_criteria: Messages are saved to the database upon sending
Database schema supports efficient storage and retrieval
Data integrity is maintained

features.title: Message History Retrieval
features.description: Allow users to retrieve message history with pagination.
acceptance_criteria: Users can request past messages
Messages are returned in paginated format
Pagination supports both forward and backward navigation

features.title: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Provide an admin dashboard to monitor active connections.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can view active WebSocket connections
Dashboard displays connection statistics
Admins can terminate connections if necessary
